angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 1,313,491 km at 60.00 pc = 0.29 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 16.6670 +/- 0.0279 mas (same row, RUWE 0.95): 60.00 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.888 (1.850 to 1.926) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source): 1,313,491 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.157 (1.117 to 1.197) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5799 +/- 1.5 K from Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 340028235795364864: teff_gspphot 5798.838 K (16th-84th percentiles 5797.52-5800.4263), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 340028235795364864: teff_gspphot 5798.838 K (16th-84th percentiles 5797.52-5800.4263), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/buna.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 3.950, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 16175 (pscomppars): spectral type G2, from Xiao et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023RAA....23e5022X/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, HD 16175: main object type PM*, High Proper Motion Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 16175 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.3 dex, from Stassun et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 16175 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.50786, from Díaz et al. 2016 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2016A&A...591A.146D/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 16175 (pscomppars): age 3.3 Gyr, from Díaz et al. 2016 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2016A&A...591A.146D/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 16175 (pscomppars): rotation period 19.7 d, from Díaz et al. 2016 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2016A&A...591A.146D/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 16175 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 4.8 km/s, from Peek et al. 2009 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2009PASP..121..613P/abstract)
spinInclinationSource: Computed here from this record's rotation period, projected rotation speed and radius (1.888 solar radii): sin i = v sin i × P / (2πR) = 0.990. Not a measurement of the axis: the three numbers come from different papers.

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from a blackbody at the star's published temperature (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
